# `company.payment_discounts`

Immutable early-payment discounts a customer receipt took, one per settlement edge.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | ix_payment_discounts_invoice, ix_payment_discounts_payment | — | Stable ULID of this discount. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_payment_discounts_payment | payment_component_keys.transaction_id | Customer receipt that took the discount. |
| `component_key_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | payment_component_keys.id | Permanent receipt component whose capacity carries the discount. |
| `application_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | applications.id | Settlement edge the discount was taken on; its amount is cash plus discount. |
| `invoice_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_payment_discounts_invoice | transactions.id | Receivable document the discount settled. |
| `discount_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account debited for the discount. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Positive discount amount. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the discount. |
| `suggested_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Discount the terms suggested for the payment date; zero after the discount date. |
| `discount_date` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | Discount date the payment was measured against; null when the terms offer none. |
| `terms_percent_millionths` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Terms discount percent in millionths of one percentage point; null when the terms offer none. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this discount was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this discount. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this discount. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this discount. |
